text:
elaine: Quick Q — I'm updating my 'home hub' ZIP from 98109 -> 94107 (moving within US). Effective 2026-04-01. Does that affect my WFH stipend proration, benefits eligibility, or state tax withholding?
people-ops: short answer: maybe. Longer: depends on whether you change your legal work location in payroll. If just updating the profile for org chart, stipend likely unaffected; if you change home base for payroll/residence, withholding and state benefits can change. Please fill the 'Work Location Change' form below so we can route to payroll and benefits.
people-ops: form: https://redwood.internal/hr/work-location-change
people-ops: Required fields: 
```
previous_zip: 98109
new_zip: 94107
effective_date: 2026-04-01
change_type: home_base_or_address
```
rafael: Hey @elaine — if you change payroll home base to CA we will start CA state withholding and SDI/CA payroll taxes; this can also affect retirement plan state tax forms. You'll also be subject to CA wage & hour regs for payroll purposes.
mike: Also flag: if too many employees move into CA it could create a tax nexus risk. People Ops or Legal will ping if aggregate headcount in a state crosses thresholds.
elaine: Got it — I plan to update payroll. What's the turnaround once I submit the form?
people-ops: Usually 1 payroll cycle to update withholding, but benefits enrollment eligibility changes may take up to 1 month (depends on COBRA/benefits carrier timing). We will confirm ETA when payroll acknowledges.
payroll-bot: Received work-location-change form for elaine at 1719072660. Processing queue: 2. ETA: 5–7 business days.
rafael: Also note WFH stipend: we prorate monthly by home hub month count. If you change mid-month we'll pro-rate the current month. We'll confirm exact proration when updating ledger.
elaine: Thanks — submitting now. Any other docs I need to attach for the CA move?
people-ops: No additional docs for internal move. If you're taking a physical office in CA or contracting locally, Legal will ask for more. We'll follow up in thread if anything else is needed. :thumbsup:
elaine: Perfect, thanks everyone.
